editorial_accuracy_note: Goldman restricted advanced coding agent tools for most traders and bankers; not a blanket AI ban. Evidence: Bloomberg Nov 2, Goldman public AI policy, company AI announcements, Reuters.

defect.issue: WordPress core/embed for user-supplied X status returned an anchor-only fallback in content.rendered rather than a native social post.
defect.attempted_repair: Retrieve raw content, replace failed X embed with contextual source link using connected update endpoint
defect.attempt_result: Not applied: wpcom/content-items-update explicitly disallows post type post; WordPress posts-update unavailable in this connected tool session.
defect.next_repair: In WordPress editor, remove failed X embed, add a contextual link to the X post or reinsert a native X block if logged-out rendering succeeds. Save, then check site on desktop/mobile. No republishing or duplicate post.
defect.regression_test: For every newly published core/embed social block, inspect content.rendered for provider iframe/blockquote; a simple anchor-only wrapper fails the embed gate.
defect.resolution: Native Gutenberg Twitter provider with canonical https://twitter.com/exec_sum/status/2117284426128179638 replaced the failed X provider block in place using WordPress post-sections.update; WordPress view output shows full quoted post, @exec_sum author, November 2, 2026 timestamp, canonical permalink, twitter-tweet blockquote and platform.x.com/widgets.js
defect.final_disposition: User requested fix embed or delete. WordPress server-render generated a full native Twitter blockquote but client-side functionality could not be independently verified; public page fetch failed. Original post 28609 moved to Trash. The corresponding GitHub archive file removed from main, preserving history in Git.

learning: A working WordPress server-rendered Twitter blockquote is not proof of browser-side embed reliability. When user reports failure and demands fix-or-delete, refrain from claiming the embed is fixed. Attempt supported provider repairs and validate via live browser; if validation remains inaccessible and user explicitly authorizes deletion, unpublish and record unresolved defect.
